stemMd: A charge of 2 microcoulombs experiences a force of 0.006 N in a uniform electric field. What is the field magnitude?
explanationMd: Field magnitude is force divided by charge: 0.006 divided by 2 times 10 to the minus six equals 3000 N/C. Converting the charge to coulombs is essential.

distractorRationale.a: This multiplies 0.006 by two and by one million, rather than dividing by 2 × 10⁻⁶ C.
distractorRationale.b: This loses a factor of ten.
